title: DBMS Normalization
text: 1NF atomic values; 2NF removes partial dependency on a composite key; 3NF removes transitive dependency; BCNF requires every determinant to be a candidate key. Anomalies: insertion, update, deletion.

title: OS CPU Scheduling
text: FCFS, SJF, Round Robin with time quantum, Priority scheduling. Metrics: turnaround time, waiting time, response time, throughput. Convoy effect in FCFS; starvation solved by aging.

title: Computer Networks OSI and TCP/IP
text: OSI has seven layers: physical, data link, network, transport, session, presentation, application. TCP/IP has four layers. TCP gives reliable ordered delivery with three-way handshake; UDP is connectionless.

title: Cryptography DES and AES
text: DES is a 64-bit block Feistel cipher with 56-bit key and 16 rounds. AES is a substitution-permutation network with 128-bit blocks and 128/192/256-bit keys using SubBytes, ShiftRows, MixColumns, AddRoundKey.

title: RPA UiPath
text: UiPath Studio builds workflows as sequences, flowcharts and state machines. Orchestrator manages robots, queues and assets. REFramework handles transactions with init, get transaction data, process, end states.

title: Machine Learning Basics
text: Supervised learning uses labelled data (regression, classification); unsupervised finds structure (clustering). Overfitting is controlled with regularization, cross-validation and more data. CNNs use convolution and pooling for images.

title: Data Structures Trees and Graphs
text: Binary search tree gives O(log n) average search; AVL trees rebalance with rotations. Graph traversal: BFS uses a queue, DFS uses a stack. Dijkstra finds shortest paths with non-negative weights; Kruskal and Prim build minimum spanning trees.

title: Java OOP Concepts
text: Four pillars: encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction. Overloading is compile-time polymorphism, overriding is runtime. Interfaces define contracts; abstract classes share state. Exceptions use try, catch, finally and throws.

title: Compiler Design Phases
text: Phases: lexical analysis, syntax analysis, semantic analysis, intermediate code generation, optimization, code generation. Parsers are top-down (LL) or bottom-up (LR, LALR). Symbol table and error handler serve all phases.

title: Software Engineering Models
text: Waterfall is sequential; the V-model pairs each phase with testing; Spiral adds risk analysis; Agile uses short iterations with Scrum sprints. Testing levels: unit, integration, system, acceptance.

title: Cloud Computing Models
text: Service models: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS. Deployment models: public, private, hybrid, community. Virtualization with hypervisors enables elasticity, pay-per-use and multi-tenancy.

title: Artificial Intelligence Search and Agents
text: Uninformed search: BFS, DFS, uniform cost. Informed search: greedy best-first and A* with an admissible heuristic. Agent types: simple reflex, model-based, goal-based, utility-based, learning agents.
